1734-3899-6132.description:

When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

670-1619-3734-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3734-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Naga Fleshcrafter and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3734-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
